items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: He played with Phil Napoleon, his band over in Brooklyn.

ctx.x: Let me see. There was a guy, there was one guy, a fiddle player named King Watsky. Do you remember him? Who? King Watsky. Watsky. He may have been before your time.
No, I, uh, there's a guy that played with, um, the trumpet player that had, uh, had, with, uh, with, uh, with, uh, with, uh, Memphis Five, what it was named, uh, Phil, uh. Phil Napoleon?
